verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents token-by-token streaming, sub-second responses, or latency behavior for Llama. The closest items are a vague mention of "agent-optimized inference" and an anecdotal community remark that the Meta Chat UI is "fast", and neither establishes a documented streaming or latency capability. Inference runtimes such as llama.cpp and partner hosts are host-platform or third-party surfaces and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented
